body: A fast inference library for running LLMs locally on modern consumer-class GPUs
plain_description: **Run large language models locally at high speed on consumer GPUs.** Generate text through a Python library or use a compatible server or web interface. Supports batch generation and custom model quantization.
technical_description: ExLlamaV2 is an inference library for running local LLMs on modern consumer GPUs. It provides Python APIs for single, batched, and streamed text generation, supports speculative decoding and GPTQ and EXL2 quantized models, and requires CUDA and PyTorch. The project is archived; its README points to TabbyAPI as the recommended backend server.
title: ExLlamaV2
